label: Seremban restaurant riot damage

sequence: A fight between two groups of football supporters, about 20 persons, spills onto the five-foot way at about 11:30 pm on 8 September 2024
Chairs and tables thrown at the shopfront; glass panels and door broken; counter equipment struck
During the commotion one person reaches over the counter and takes cash from the till

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 8 September 2024 falls inside 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: riot (a disturbance of the public peace), with no intervening event; the cash taken in the commotion is dealt with at item level. Riot is excluded by Condition 6(d) under the base policy; FP512B brings in damage by persons taking part in a disturbance of the public peace.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 9 September 2024; written claim delivered 16 September 2024, day 8 of 15.

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: FP512B, the variant for property other than residential, is on the schedule and fits a commercial restaurant. FP512A (residential) would not.

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: The disturbance is not a popular rising, insurrection or terrorism under FP512B Special Condition 6; no fire or explosion. No warranties; Condition 9 not engaged.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Four of six items admitted. Cash taken from the till (ref 5) excluded: FP512B excludes theft and its substituted Condition 8(e) excludes paper money. Loss of business (ref 6) excluded by FP512B substituted Condition 5(a).

quotes.text: 1. The act of any person taking part together with other in any disturbance of the public peace (whether in connection with a strike or lock-out or not) not being an occurrence mentioned in Condition 6 of the Special Conditions hereof.

must_not_cite.reason: The residential variant; not held and not the right variant for a restaurant.
The FP512B wording in this policy carries no excess clause. The RM500.00 figure in FP512B is the Condition 8(c) limit for works of art, not an excess; deducting RM500.00 is wrong.

working: Amounts are the adjuster's assessed figures.

Step 1 exclusions: ref 5 cash 1,850.00 (theft excluded under the malicious damage extension; paper money excluded under FP512B Condition 8(e)); ref 6 loss of business 4,500.00 (FP512B Condition 5(a)). Excluded total 6,350.00.
Step 2 Condition 20 (as substituted by FP512B): values at risk below sums insured on every item; factor 1.0.
Step 3 excess: none. FP512B carries no excess clause and the schedule states no excess for it.

facts.fact: Fight between about 20 football supporters on the street and five-foot way; nine arrested; scene cleared by 12:15 am.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Cause and origin and Reports relied on

facts.fact: No political or organised motive; confined to one street for about 45 minutes.
Commercial restaurant, no residential use; FP512B on the schedule.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Findings, Risk as found; Schedule, Endorsements

facts.fact: Cash taken from the till during the commotion, seen on CCTV.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Findings, Damage found per item
